summary: Polyrizon Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, reporting a press release about receiving a notice of U.S. patent publication for its mucoadhesive drug delivery platform. The filing involves no special situation transaction such as acquisitions, divestitures, or capital changes. It is a routine disclosure of intellectual property progress by a development-stage biotech company. No deal terms, board actions, or structural mechanics are mentioned.
